glyph_rationales.0: M13: the kept blank place — positional notation makes absence a practical difficulty (205 loses its hundreds if the place is dropped); the sign before it is a numeral
glyph_rationales.What knows?: the essay's opening question (M01): every description of the I is something known, and the knowing in which it is read is not among the things it describes — the formal limit stated before any notation
glyph_rationales.the unnamed: M02: the child entirely itself between the parents' argued names — the referent held one through a change of hands, before any numeral is recited
glyph_rationales.this one: M02/M06: the count beneath naming — an act of identifying through difference ('this one'), the same act a count performs on its unit
glyph_rationales.this one again: M02/M06: the count's retention ('this one again') — identifying through difference continued; Kripke's dice: keep the assignment, not only the total
glyph_rationales.prakāśa: M07: the luminosity of appearing — voice, face, place as they show themselves before they are addressed
glyph_rationales.vimarśa: M07: the reflexive bend by which luminous awareness takes its own manifestation as other enough to encounter — the first differentiation
glyph_rationales.buddhi: M08: the inner instrument's judgment — the part of the antaḥkaraṇa that determines; mediating apparatus, not the subject
glyph_rationales.ahaṃkāra: M08: appropriation — the instrument's identification through which a call becomes a grievance or a task
glyph_rationales.manas: M08: coordination — the instrument that gathers what attention selects; an operation through which, not a musician who
glyph_rationales.śūnya: M14: zero operational — the same zero enters two operations with different consequences (a+0=a, a·0=0); absence with arithmetic force (Brahmagupta, khahara)
glyph_rationales.∅: M15: the empty set that generates one — the von Neumann construction (0=∅, 1={∅}): what can be generated from an apparently meagre beginning
glyph_rationales.0/1: M18: the loan returned — the earned relational notation (§1 · #5→0): ground and mark held in one relation after history, operations, generation, occlusion and the failed quotient
glyph_rationales.1/0: M17/M18: the failed quotient and the obverse orientation — 0·q=1 is impossible in a field (the frame disclosed at zero), and the retained boundary pair of the mediant construction
glyph_rationales.−/−: M20: the bare relation before signs — a stroke between two unassigned marks, positions before a determinate contrast is given
glyph_rationales.(−1)/(+1): M20: dia-ballein's polar form — positive and negative held through a common zero; the stroke retains a polarity rather than instructing division
glyph_rationales.(−1)+(+1)=0: M20: the collapsed operation — addition cancels to 0 and subtraction appropriates the span; changing the operation changes the result
glyph_rationales.(0/1)/(1/0): M21: sym-ballein — superpositional polarity as inverse orientations of one retained ground–mark relation; recognition through the maintained break
glyph_rationales.4+2: M26/M29: two terms plus the four ordered relations — what a two amounts to once it includes itself; also the genus-one presentation (4g sides + 2g generators)
glyph_rationales.χ=0: M29: the torus's Euler characteristic — genus one, where local closure and retained global displacement coexist exactly (T²=R²/Z²)
glyph_rationales.9/8: M29: the remainder — 16/9 falls short of the octave by 9/8; the live tick that gives the next cycle something to begin from (return through, not by eliminating, the remainder)
glyph_rationales.arche-topos: M30: the authorial Arche-Topos — the derived formal synthesis where charts, transitions and lifts hold a situated place-field; Derived formal coordination inside the native framework
glyph_rationales.psyche: M31: the psychic description — one side of the psychoid threshold; image and meaning retained without reduction to mechanism
glyph_rationales.physis: M31: the physical description — the other side of the same unmastered threshold; event and matter retained without reduction to psychology
glyph_rationales.X: M32: determining capacity — the QL matheme's capital term, legible only through concrete transformations
glyph_rationales.x: M32: the indefinite particular — no determination exhausts the whole; the local case through which capacity becomes legible
glyph_rationales.X/x: M32: the matheme itself — determining capacity and local manifestation in one relation; individuation as a local x transparent to the larger relation
